prompt: Political positions of Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono? Include at least 10 single-word palindromes, each at least 5 characters long.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 4 is the most prompt-aligned: it names multiple plausible high-level political priorities for SBY and includes a near-complete set of single-word palindromes (the main issue is that “deed” is only 4 characters). Candidate 1 also provides single-word palindromes but similarly fails the length requirement with “deed,” and it makes more dubious, overly specific claims tied to the palindrome puns (e.g., military “radar” upgrades). Candidates 2 and 3 largely fail the palindrome constraint by using multi-word palindrome phrases, and both also avoid giving actual non-fiction political positions (explicitly fictionalized in 2).
